label: PF Backlog 696
title: CAG Context Cache: pre-computed static context caching, prefix KV-cache reuse, and deterministic invalidation hooks
body:
## Problem / why
Static and slow-moving context (system prompts, tool specs, core platform rules) is redundantly serialized and parsed on every LLM call.

## Goal & value
Deliver Cache-Augmented Generation (CAG) with pre-computed prefix caching and deterministic invalidation hooks.

## Reference Documents
- `docs/Product_Forge_RAG_CAG_Knowledge_Fabric_Integration.md#section-10`
- `docs/Product_Forge_RAG_CAG_Knowledge_Fabric_Integration.md#section-11`

## In scope
- Prefix context cache generating deterministic keys from content hashes.
- Invalidation hooks bound to git commit SHAs, file updates, and config changes.
- Freshness validation preventing stale cache injection.

## Out of scope
- Caching dynamic per-run agent scratchpad state.

## Definition of Done
- Cache invalidation and freshness integration tests pass with zero stale hits.

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Caches static system prompts and rule sets with deterministic SHA-256 keys.
AC-2: Modifying an underlying source document or rule invalidates the cache immediately.
AC-3: Reduces prompt token consumption by >=40% on repeated invocations.
